verdict_reason: The commoditySelection rename is correct, but two other recipe snippets still name a removed constant and a moved, re-signatured seedLine call.

todos.issue: The recipe's commodity snippets point at code this PR renamed or removed, and the PR updated only the commoditySelection lines next to them. Line 135 uses PACKAGE_COUNT_COMMODITIES, which no longer exists: lines.js now calls allowListed(commodityCode, packageCountCommodityCodes, null, ...). Lines 247-258 say the search page.js reconciles 'one line per selected species' with selected.map(seedLine). That call is now in search/actions/commit-selection.js. It reads rows.map(seedLine), where seedLine takes a search row ({ commodityCode, speciesLatinName, commonName }), and it then calls clearStoredSearchRows.
todos.fix: Must: every identifier, file path and call in the recipe's commodity snippets matches the code at this commit, so a developer copying the recipe gets code that resolves. One way: change line 135 to packageCountCommodityCodes. Point the batch-split section at search/actions/commit-selection.js and show rows.map(seedLine), described as one line per selected search row (code plus Latin name).
